g.text: Rollout: four phases, each one shippable
Order matters: the boundary first, then the credentials, then the guardrails. Stop after any phase and the system is still usable, and safer than it was.
done: a direct curl times out
done: every action has a lease id
one debugging session, never daily work
no paid service, no cloud control plane,
everything runs on this host and stays auditable.
docker run --rm --network none IMG curl -m2 https://github.com
# expect timeout · then repeat through the proxy
